trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 7608724. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as Jorge I. Poveda and Andrew R. Teel, 'A Hybrid Dynamical Systems Perspective on Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems: Vistas, Open Problems, and Challenges', DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-60990-0_24, in Handbook of Reinforcement Learning and Control, pages 727-762.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. Direct local shell fetching of zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution failure in the restricted environment, and the web fetch for the exact zbMATH URL returned no readable record body. The Springer DOI landing page was reachable but exposed only an abstract, notes, references, citation metadata, and subscription/purchase prompts, not full chapter text.

Identifier-specific recovery used the DOI and exact title. The Poveda publications page confirmed the same chapter but linked only to the Springer landing page. The OUCI page confirmed the same title, authors, DOI, publisher, and page range but was a bibliographic metadata and reference-list page. Searches by exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, and exact title plus authors did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source; inspected candidates were metadata, abstracts, bibliographies, request-only pages, paywalled Springer previews, or different works.
No document map was produced because no readable primary PDF or full HTML source for the exact zbMATH/DOI work was recovered.

Candidate extraction was not performed. Per the source-adequacy and no-new-facts gates, questions were not extracted from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, reference lists, author bibliography entries, resolver records, search snippets, or paywalled preview pages.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because the bounded recovery pass did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
